Valid values: `absent`, `present`, `installed`, `latest`

Aliases: `"installed"=>"present"`

The basic property that the resource should be in.

##### <a name="-cpan--environment"></a>`environment`

List of environment variables in the form of a Hash

##### <a name="-cpan--exists_strategy"></a>`exists_strategy`

Valid values: `include`, `find`

Strategy to test for module existence

Default value: `include`

##### <a name="-cpan--force"></a>`force`

Valid values: `true`, `false`, `yes`, `no`

Enable/Disable to force the installation of the module. Disabled by default.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-cpan--local_lib"></a>`local_lib`

Destination directory or `false`

##### <a name="-cpan--name"></a>`name`

namevar

The name of the module.

##### <a name="-cpan--provider"></a>`provider`

The specific backend to use for this `cpan` resource. You will seldom need to specify this --- Puppet will usually
discover the appropriate provider for your platform.

umask to run cpan with
